instruction: Configure my Mail.com account in Thunderbird using the email address "premium.demo2024@mail.com" and password 'mailcom_premium' (without quotes). It doesn't matter if Thunderbird shows login or connection failures. Just complete the account setup procedure and I'll handle credential verification manually.

metadata.explanation: Task variation for Mail.com account setup in Thunderbird. Evaluator checks IMAP (imap.mail.com) and SMTP (smtp.mail.com) account configurations with correct credentials.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses firefox_decrypt.py to extract Thunderbird credentials from profile directory
Complete coverage: checks both IMAP and SMTP account configurations as required
Expected values are semantically correct and match instruction requirements exactly (email: premium.demo2024@mail.com, password: mailcom_premium, servers: imap.mail.com and smtp.mail.com)
Metric function check_csv appropriately validates that all expected credential records exist in the CSV output
Postconfig correctly executes after task completion to extract stored credentials from Thunderbird profile
Logic flow is sound: user configures account -> credentials stored in profile -> postconfig extracts to CSV -> check_csv validates entries
Instruction states connection failures don't matter - evaluator correctly only checks if configuration was saved, not if login succeeded
Edge cases handled: check_csv returns 0.0 for None result, properly parses CSV with DictReader, validates all expected records
